build_bbox: build a bounding box from image dimensions and pixel coordinates using normalized values
extract_annotation: extract bounding box annotation info including id, area, bbox, and label from a COCO annotation
generate_examples: generate image examples with referring expressions and ground truth bounding boxes from RefCoco JSON
create_refcoco_config: create a RefCocoConfig specifying dataset variant and partition for RefCoco dataset builder
build_refcoco_builder: build a RefCoco GeneratorBasedBuilder with multiple dataset variants and split configurations
